name: software-architecture
summary: A product's architecture, pattern-neutral: its context and drivers, decisions with their alternatives, systems, components, interfaces, data stores and environments, each traced to the requirement it satisfies; each part handed to the design-pattern pack it follows, found among the project's packs.

changelog.note: Republished from the engine at ontology release 12 (was 10) under ADR-0011: the engine ships no domain vocabulary, and this pack is the only software-architecture there is.
The studio's page: How it is designed.
architecture-build hands over to the binding after the parts and their patterns: where it runs.
Every conversation in plain language: no codes, ids or engine output, technical details only when asked (engine 0.11.22).
The architecture, pattern-neutral: architecture-build, which hands each part to the pattern pack it follows, found in oto status. Split from prd-architecture-studio. Needs OTO 0.11.17.

_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
